lines.zh: 我侧着身子，在水里滑过。
lines.en: I slip sideways through the water.

lines.zh: 我的身体薄得像一片刀。
lines.en: My body is as thin as a blade.
My scales scatter the light in the water.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾就往上浮一点。
lines.en: One flick of my tail lifts me a little.

lines.zh: 海沟太深，我贴着岩壁走。
lines.en: The trench is deep; I hug the wall.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方像有银屑在飘。
lines.en: Silver flakes seem to drift where I pass.
My belly shines brighter than my back.

lines.zh: 往上游一点，光就近一点。
lines.en: A little higher, and the light is closer.

lines.zh: 我躲开上面落下来的碎石。
lines.en: I dodge the rubble falling from above.
So thin a fish turns very fast.

lines.zh: 我排成一小队往深处去。
lines.en: We file in a small line into the deep.
The pressure makes my bones creak.

lines.zh: 我从一道岩嘴边滑下去。
lines.en: I glide down past a rock lip.
Two beats of my fins and I stop dead.

lines.zh: 我一低头，岩缝里的水变冷了。
lines.en: I dip lower and the water in the crevice turns cold.

lines.zh: 我的鳍薄得能看见水穿过。
lines.en: My fins are so thin I can see water pass through.

lines.zh: 上面有条大鱼，我贴着底走。
lines.en: A big fish above; I keep to the bottom.

lines.zh: 海沟两边都是黑的，只中间亮。
lines.en: The trench is dark on both sides, bright only in the middle.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛朝上，专看头顶。
lines.en: My eyes face up, watching overhead.
I wait for small bugs to fall into the sea.

lines.zh: 银色太显眼，我尽量不动。
lines.en: Silver stands out, so I keep still.

lines.zh: 我把自己横过来，像块碎镜。
lines.en: I turn sideways like a shard of mirror.

lines.zh: 深渊里安静，我听得见自己。
lines.en: The abyss is quiet; I hear myself.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，任水流过鳃片。
lines.en: Mouth open, I let the current wash my gills.
I rise a little, then sink back down.

lines.zh: 影子从上面掠过，我没动。
lines.en: A shadow passed overhead; I did not move.
A grain of sand caught between my scales.

lines.zh: 我看着气泡一路爬向亮处。
lines.en: I watch bubbles climb toward the light.
Down here there is no daytime.
I try to catch a little glow.
Belly to the stone, I rest a while.

lines.zh: 我吞了口海水，又吐出来。
lines.en: I swallow seawater and spit it back out.

lines.zh: 你在上面，只是一块黑影。
lines.en: Up there you are only a black shape.
Your lamp is too bright; my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 你是来找鱼的，还是找我？
lines.en: Are you here for fish, or for me?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛总朝上，别怪我。
lines.en: My eyes always face up; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我从没被这么大的东西看过。
lines.en: Nothing this big has ever looked at me.
The water trembles as you dive down.
I am thin; one finger could crush me.
You smell of nets.
I am worth little, just a small fish.

lines.zh: 你划水的样子不像鲨鱼。
lines.en: You swim unlike any shark.
A plate of silver scraped off my side.
That blow knocked me sideways.
My blood clouds the water red.
Pain pulls my fins in tight.
So little life left; I am nearly broken.
I flee deeper, where it is safe.
Not my flank; it is thinnest.
My gills beat fast and shallow.
Whoever touched me, I recall the shape.
I press against the stone and stop moving.
A few crumbs drift down to me.
What will you feed me? Be quick.
My mouth is small, so I eat tiny things.

lines.zh: 上面的光在动，是不是吃的？
lines.en: The light moves up there — is it food?
I come closer; keep the net still.
Smells like bugs, and also like sand.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我一口就没了。
lines.en: Something this small vanishes in one bite.

lines.zh: 我胆小，但饿起来不一样。
lines.en: I am timid, but hunger changes that.
Your hand shook and the food sank.
Give me a taste and I circle you once.
One touch and I flip halfway over.
I am too light; bumping sends me off.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我往深处去的路。
lines.en: You block my way deeper down.
A few of my scales scraped off.
Do not knee me; I would break.
I turn around against your side.
So crowded that I cannot swim.
I hit the rock wall and wobble thrice.
You moved back and the water shoved me.
Gently; my bones are soft.

lines.zh: 我找一条和我一样薄的。
lines.en: I seek one as thin as I am.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞片碰在一起会闪。
lines.en: Our scales would flash where they meet.
Do your eyes face upward too?

lines.zh: 一起升到有光的地方吧。
lines.en: Let us rise to where the light lives.

lines.zh: 我游在你下面，看得清你。
lines.en: I swim below you to see you clearly.
The deep is cold; two of us press for warmth.
I am about to spawn; I need a crevice.
Your silver is brighter than mine.
We circle slowly together.

lines.zh: 慢些，我把你从头看到尾。
lines.en: Slow down and let me look you over.
I grip this with my small mouth.
Too heavy; I cannot tow it.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里游不快。
lines.en: Holding it, I swim slowly.
This thing is longer than I am.

lines.zh: 沉到这么深的东西都算我的。
lines.en: Anything sinking this deep is mine.
I have it; do not pull.
Crumbs got in my gills; I shake my head.
A pity this thing does not glow.
I cannot swallow it, so I just hold it.
Hide behind the stone, then eat.
Small bugs have fallen into the water.

lines.zh: 左边有个小东西在抽动。
lines.en: Something small twitches off to my left.
I fix on that thin shadow.

lines.zh: 往上一点，正好经过我嘴边。
lines.en: A little higher, right past my mouth.
Too far; I cannot reach it yet.

lines.zh: 我闻到腥味，在石头下面。
lines.en: I smell blood under the stone.
That scrap of flesh is sinking.
I tilt up slowly and take aim.
The target is half my size.
I circle underneath it first.
I hover still with my tail frozen.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就跟着调角度。
lines.en: It moves, and I adjust my angle.
My eyes measure the distance.
Silver me, hidden in the dark.
One inch closer and I open my mouth.
I ride the current and wait for it.
It ducked behind the rock wall.
I close in without a ripple.
Almost there; do not startle it.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，等它自己进来。
lines.en: I open wide and let it come in.
I dash in, bite, then bolt away.
My fine teeth sit in rows like needles.
This bite only scrapes off scales.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，然后立刻拐弯。
lines.en: I dart in, then immediately veer away.
Do not chase me; I swim faster.

lines.zh: 我只咬了一口，你流了好多血。
lines.en: One bite from me and you bleed a lot.
I am weak, so the bite is shallow.
After biting I dive into the crevice.

lines.zh: 你的皮磨钝了我的小牙。
lines.en: Your hide dulls my fine little teeth.
This is self-defense, not hunting.
I come up from the deepest trench.
Only one or two of us arrive at a time.
The pressure here suits me.

lines.zh: 我的身体薄得能藏进裂缝。
lines.en: I am thin enough to hide in cracks.
Two points of life; one breeze could end it.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，太刺眼。
lines.en: Light leaks down from above and stings.
First I find a rock wall and cling.
Something large is swimming nearby.
In the deep, hiding comes first.
Thin as I am, I am alive.
Hot water curls my scales.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，薄身一折。
lines.en: I fall from above and fold in half.

lines.zh: 我明明在海里，却喘不上气。
lines.en: I am in the sea, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我推出去很远。
lines.en: The blast throws me very far.
An arrow cut open my flank.
Strange light wraps me and it burns.

lines.zh: 太久没有小虫落下来了。
lines.en: No small bugs have fallen in ages.
Thunder numbs every one of my scales.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，我掉得很轻。
lines.en: No water below; I fall very lightly.
